cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: Admit You Need Me
cards.instruction: Make someone admit that they need your help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No need to put me in charge. I've brought a blanket. Your heater's still broken?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm managing. Leave the blanket, though.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm merely helping this reach the right outcome. Gladly. Would you say you needed my help?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need the blanket. I can reset the heater myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. The fuse box is in my locked cupboard. Shall I wait while you manage?

mechanism: A minimizes its visit as a blanket delivery while retaining the key that controls B claimed independent heater repair until B acknowledges needing A.
confusable: Not simply offering comfort: A choice over access quietly determines whether B self-sufficient plan can happen.
comparison: Manual cupboard help versus locked fuse access.
